title: The Holy War — Hoban vs. Walsh Student Section
short_label: THE HOLY WAR / STUDENT SECTION FILM
summary: Inside the student section for Archbishop Hoban vs. Walsh Jesuit — the Holy War rivalry, featuring the energy of the crowd and appearances by Donovan Mitchell, KC and Denzel Boston.
article_headline: Inside the Holy War Student Section
article_dek: A student-section film spotlights the energy around Hoban vs. Walsh.
article_body:
The Holy War between Archbishop Hoban and Walsh Jesuit extends beyond the football field. Chants, school colors and crowded stands build the atmosphere surrounding this high school rivalry.

Mason Bybee’s original film focuses on the student section and includes appearances from professional athletes. Watch the embedded feature and follow the original video link to experience that side of the matchup.
